Name: Mini Greenhouse in the Farmhouse 2
Author: Suzilana
Description:
[ Content Patcher ] mod that slightly transforms the extended corner room of the house renovation by adding a plantable area in the greenhouse style 🌱

This is a new version of my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13619](Outdated) Mini Greenhouse in the Farmhouse[/url], which broke after the SV 1.6 release. I couldn't update it as it was because the layout of the house changed and it was now standing on the cubby.

I hope users of the first mod will like this one too (◕ᴗ◕✿)
